patterns_found.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
patterns_found.evidence: Prior bearish structure of lower highs and lower lows from 67000 down to 62200 was invalidated. Price made a higher low at approximately 64000 after the head low, then broke above the previous swing high at approximately 65500, shifting market structure to bullish.

patterns_found.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders
patterns_found.evidence: Distinct head formed at approximately 62200. Left shoulder low near 64000-64500 before the drop. Right shoulder low near 64000-64500 after the initial bounce. Neckline resistance around 65500 was broken with a rally to approximately 66000. Price currently at 65414 is retesting the neckline area.

patterns_found.name: Bullish Flag
patterns_found.evidence: Strong impulse rally from approximately 62200 to 66000 followed by tight consolidation between 65000 and 65800, forming a potential bullish flag pattern after the impulse move.

vlm_analysis.visual_evidence: BTC/USDT 15m chart shows a clear shift from bearish to bullish structure. Price formed an inverse head and shoulders with head at approximately 62200, shoulders near 64000-64500, and neckline around 65500. Breakout above the neckline reached approximately 66000 before the current retest to 65414. CHoCH is confirmed as price broke prior lower highs. A bullish flag consolidation is developing after the impulse rally.
limitations: 15m timeframe is susceptible to noise and false signals
Current candle may still be forming, altering pattern context
Volume confirmation is not fully conclusive from visual inspection
Pattern retest could fail, invalidating the breakout
